subject: BridgeFoundry voucher smoothing proposal
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex@bridgefoundry.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: BridgeFoundry voucher smoothing proposal

Alex —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation I wanted to put a short written proposal on how we can make the remaining accelerator voucher balance easier to consume over Q4 without causing accounting churn on your side. High level:

- Allow a one-time voucher rollover of up to 40% of unused credits from the current cohort into a 6-month smoothing pool.
- Offer a onetime top-up to cover onboarding headroom (up to $10k in credits) so teams can start building without hitting throttles.
- If BridgeFoundry commits to a 6-month minimum usage step (soft commit), we can add a 10% volume discount on standard per-token rates for that window.

I've attached a short one-pager with example math and the proposal language so your finance folks can review quickly (BF_voucher_smoothing_v1.pdf). We're aiming for a lightweight amendment rather than a full contract reissue — happy to route to legal if you prefer.

Can you confirm who on your side should review for procurement/finance? If it works, I can follow up with a redline-friendly snippet for DocuSign.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Torres <alex@bridgefoundry.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, BridgeFoundry Finance <finance@bridgefoundry.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeFoundry voucher smoothing proposal

Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary, appreciate how concise that is. Two quick clarifying questions before I loop finance:

1) For the "one-time top-up": is that a promo credit (no cash value) or an invoiced discount? Our controller needs to know the accounting treatment.
2) If we accept the smoothing roll, will that change the end date for the current voucher (i.e., are we effectively extending the expiration)?

CC'd our finance lead — hi team, could you flag whether a PO will be required for any top-up amount?

If both are workable I'd like to aim for a signed amendment by end of week.

—Alex
Alex Torres | Partner Success, BridgeFoundry
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex@bridgefoundry.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeFoundry voucher smoothing proposal

Alex / team —

Quick answers and an explicit option set so procurement has something to review:

Option A — Promo-only (lowest friction)
- Top-up: $10,000 in promo credits (no cash value).
- Rollover: up to 40% of unused accelerator voucher moved into a 6-month smoothing pool.
- Expiration: smoothing pool expires 6 months after amendment effective date.
- Accounting: treated as promo/marketing credit; no invoice or PO required.

Option B — Financial amendment (PO + invoice)
- Top-up: $10,000 applied as a prepaid credit on an invoice (reduces future usage bill).
- Rollover: same 40% rollover.
- Discount: 10% committed usage discount for 6 months after activation.
- Accounting: requires a PO and standard invoicing cadence; credits appear on ledger.

Option C — Hybrid (recommended if you want both controls)
- $5k promo top-up + $5k prepaid credit; smaller PO required; 8% discount for 6 months.

Notes:
- We can do a minimal amendment (1–2 paragraphs) to the existing MSA to document the smoothing pool and top-up; no model change required.
- If BridgeFoundry prefers a longer smoothing window (9–12 months) we can push a slightly lower discount but that will impact the top-up size.

I've attached the one-pager and a sample amendment draft. If finance confirms PO/no-PO, Ben and I will spin the DocuSign link and the redline.

Kim
Kimberly Park | Head, Regional Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachment: BF_voucher_smoothing_v1.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex@bridgefoundry.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeFoundry voucher smoothing proposal

Alex / Finance —

Appreciate the quick loop. From Redwood's side we can be flexible; operational ask is to lock a short activation window once you sign so the smoothing pool and discount are enabled within the same billing cycle. Our counter-proposal (to keep the economics simple):

- Offer: Option B with a 15% discount for the first 3 months (instead of 10%) if BridgeFoundry signs and returns PO by EOD Friday; thereafter it steps to 10% for the remaining 3 months.
- Condition: If usage exceeds the smoothing pool by >25% in any calendar month, the discount steps down to 5% that month (we'll still honor credits already applied).

Deal metadata for procurement: Deal ID BF-2026-0473, anticipated invoice amount for prepaid credit path = $10,000 (if you pick Option B).

If that timeline is tight, we can accept a hybrid PO + email confirmation to expedite legal templates.

Thanks — Ben
From: BridgeFoundry Finance <finance@bridgefoundry.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Torres <alex@bridgefoundry.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeFoundry voucher smoothing proposal

Ben / Kim / Alex —

We reviewed the three options internally. BridgeFoundry is willing to proceed with Option B on the condition that: 1) the 6-month smoothing pool expiration is explicitly stated in the amendment, 2) the initial 15% introductory discount is limited to the first invoice cycle after activation (we cannot commit to retroactive adjustments), and 3) Redwood provides a PO-friendly invoice/credit memos template.

Please prepare the DocuSign amendment with those three items called out. We've attached a PO stub for the $10,000 prepaid credit (BF_PO_stub.pdf) — legal will countersign once the amendment arrives.

Alex will own the internal sign-off; Ben / Kimberly please send the DocuSign link and include the HubSpot deal ID (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/473).

Thanks,
Maya Singh | Finance Lead, BridgeFoundry
BridgeFoundry Finance
Attachment: BF_PO_stub.pdf
